newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Faulding to buy research firm.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Faulding to buy research firm.

text.p: International pharmaceuticals group FH Faulding and Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it had reached agreement to buy all the issued shares of contract research firm Soltec Research Pty Ltd of Rowville, Victoria.
Terms were not disclosed but Faulding said it would issue 1.46 million shares valued at A$8.21 each (A$12 million) to partly fund the purchase.

Julian Clark, group director, Faulding development and operations, said in a statement the acqusition of Soltec Research was in line with Faulding's vision with its primary focus on delivering innovative and valued healthcare solutions.

"Soltec Research's technical expertise in physical chemistry, formulation and innovative technologies will complement Faulding's vision, broaden its competence base, contacts, and further strengthen its ability to meet market needs," Clark said.
Soltec was likely to play an important part within Faulding in areas such as taste-masked formulations and topical drug delivery, Faulding said.

It said Soltec was an innovation and contract research and development company, focusing on chemical formulations and delivery systems for prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer over-the-counter products and personal healthcare products.

Its recent focus on research and development had resulted in a strong portfolio of licensed and soon-to-be licensed technologies and its technologies base provided an added value to leading brands in aerosols, sunscreens and lotions, it said.
Soltec would continue to be managed as a separate unit by founder and managing director Rod Tomlinson, Faulding said.
Faulding said confidentiality undertakings did not allow the disclosure of certain financial information relating to the transaction.
